question:
Refer to the exhibit. A DevOps engineer must create a PowerShell script to display a list of tenants in the Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI) by using the Cisco ACI PowerShell module. The engineer does NOT know how many results will be returned, so it is important to iterate through all the results. Which code snippet completes the script?
1 Write-Host "Retrieving list of tenants on ACI"
2 $tenanturl = $baseurl + "/api/node/class/fvTenant.json"
3 $webobj = new-object net.webclient
4 $webobj.Headers.add("Cookie", $cookies)
5 $result = $webobj.DownloadString($tenanturl)
6 $resultjson = $result | convertfrom-json
7 $tenants = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
theory: Because the number of tenants returned is unknown ahead of time, the script must iterate over every element of the $resultjson.imdata array rather than assume a fixed count; PowerShell's foreach loop naturally walks the whole collection, pulling each tenant's fvTenant.attributes.name out on every pass. The other snippets rely on invalid pseudo-code ('While true (...)') or manual indexing without a proper loop terminator, which wouldn't safely cover a variable-length result set. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 17 — Evaluate Automation and Orchestration Technologies)
